notes.note: #2494 slice 2 (Seatbelt for Claude): a workspace Claude start at never now keeps never and resolves a spawn-wrapper os-profile plan (mechanism seatbelt) instead of the approval posture's never->auto downgrade; the Claude adapter spawns the engine through the provider's confine() (sandbox-exec with a broad-read, narrow-write profile), observes the posture through pending.observe after the initialize handshake, and only then lifts acceptEdits to bypassPermissions; a turn keeps never only for a session whose latest start record is an observed confined posture. Non-macOS hosts or a missing sandbox-exec refuse such a start; no confined credential (env key/token or a credential file in the Station-owned config dir; the operator Keychain is hidden and never copied), adoption/source-affinity resume, a too-broad workspace or a resume under another config home fall back to Auto with a derived fallback reason on the record. OrchestrationService adds the Seatbelt provider to its default providers and gives ApprovalPosture an observed-record reader; the record gains optional writeGrants and fallback. Searched this document for confinement, sandbox, full access/never mapping, Claude config home and Keychain claims: none describes the changed behavior, so no prose change.
